title: "የማያውቁት ነገር ላብ ያበረክታል"
story_summary: A young highland farmer exhausts himself trying to break rocky soil with brute force alone. His grandfather quietly steps in—not with a lecture, but by adjusting his grip and rhythm—showing that balance and ancestral technique triumph over raw strain, embodying the Ethiopian proverb: 'የማያውቁት ነገር ላብ ያበረክታል'.
style_block: Cinematic photorealistic 35mm film still, authentic Ethiopian highland rural setting, natural earthy tones (ochre soil, weathered acacia wood, off-white handwoven cotton Gabi), subtle atmospheric dust, shallow depth of field, 24fps film grain, highly detailed skin textures and fabric weaves, centered composition suitable for 9:16 and 16:9 crops, no modern artifacts.

character_refs.kaleb: 17-year-old lean Ethiopian highland farmer with short curly black textured hair, high cheekbones, wearing a dusty rough homespun earthen-tan cotton tunic with open V-neck, sweat glistening on forehead (token_kaleb.jpg)

character_refs.doma: Traditional Ethiopian agricultural hand-hoe (doma): a straight weathered wooden handle with a round iron collar ring at the bottom tip and ONE single curved broad iron hoe blade extending to one side only (asymmetric single-sided hoe blade, NO rear spike, NO T-shaped double-sided head, NO axe head) (token_doma.jpg)
character_refs.injured_palm: Close-up macro of blistered and dirt-stained palm (medaf) with raw chafed skin from grueling agricultural labor (token_injured_palm.jpg)
character_refs.landscape: Authentic Ethiopian highland terraced fields with dry furrowed soil, stone boundary walls, and rolling acacia-dotted hills (token_landscape.jpg)
character_refs.rural_house: Traditional rural highland stone-and-mud house with corrugated iron roof and dry stone terrace wall (token_rural_house.jpg)
